换个关键词，或清除筛选重新探索。: Try another keyword or clear the filters.
此历史案例没有可运行示范。: This legacy case has no runnable demo.
五个地质案例与历史测井示范。导入的案例仅保存在当前浏览器。: Five geology experiments and a legacy well-log demo. Imported cases are stored in this browser.
经典动态规划分层教学示范。: A teaching demonstration of dynamic-programming well-log segmentation.
把你的案例，放进地图。: Bring your case to the atlas.
统一的旧包协议，加上可独立运行的单文件入口。: A shared legacy package contract, plus standalone HTML support.
清单保留 id、sceneId、title、tabs.background、ta: Keep id, sceneId, title, tabs.background, tabs.workflow and tabs.demo in the manifest. Add a case by dropping a folder, choosing a folder or selecting multiple files.
上传含 atlas-case-manifest JSON 元信息块的单 HTML: Import an HTML file containing an atlas-case-manifest JSON block. Download any of the five built-in cases as a reference.
支持 page、module、builtin、auto。清单不能有 script: Supports page, module, builtin and auto modes. Manifests cannot contain script tags. For the legacy site, use a release/legacy folder; extract ZIP files first.
场景 ID 继承旧站；地质勘察为 g1—g4。一个场景允许多个不同 ID 案例。: Scenario IDs follow the legacy site; geology uses g1–g4. A scenario may contain multiple unique case IDs. Packages are limited to 6 MiB. Explain the domain background, method and data source.
改动保存在当前浏览器，发布共享需要重新构建或导出案例。: Changes stay in this browser. Rebuild or export your cases to share them.
跨地址无法直接读取旧浏览器存储，请使用备份文件迁移。原旧站管理页仍可在兼容工作台: Browser storage is isolated by origin. Use a backup to move content between addresses. The full legacy editor remains available in the compatibility workspace.
拖入完整文件夹或单文件 HTML。所有计算和保存均在本机完成。: Drop a case folder or a self-contained HTML file. Computation and storage remain on your device.
无法读取本地案例存储: Local case storage could not be read.
请修正后重试: Correct the issues and try again
校验通过，可试跑或添加: Validation passed. Preview or add the case.
保存失败，案例尚未添加，请导出备份并检查浏览器存储。: Save failed. Export a backup and check browser storage before retrying.
移除此案例？内置案例可恢复，本地案例需重新导入。: Remove this case? Built-in cases can be restored; local cases must be imported again.
迁移失败，原数据保留：: Migration failed; original data is preserved:

从观测，到理解，再到验证: Observe. Understand. Put it to the test.
从熟悉的方法出发，寻找业务中的落点。: Start with a familiar method and find its use in the field.
选择一个节点，查看它能处理的数据与问题。: Choose a node to explore its data and applications.

拖动旋转 · 点击层位: Drag to rotate · Select a layer
概念模型 / 非真实剖面: Concept model / Not a field section
遥感影像记录地表纹理，岩性与植被共同影响观测。: Remote imagery records surface texture. Both rocks and vegetation shape what we observe.
孔隙与裂隙提供储集空间；模型中的层位仅作概念示意。: Pores and fractures provide storage space. These model layers are conceptual.
致密岩层影响流体运移。拖动剖面，观察层间空间关系。: Tight rock affects fluid migration. Rotate the section to inspect how layers relate.
地下结构无法仅由地表唯一推断，需要多种观测相互验证。: Surface observations do not uniquely determine subsurface structure. Multiple observations are needed.
案例方法概念预览，非实际计算结果: Conceptual method preview, not a computed result
小写字母、数字、连字符，全站唯一。: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; unique across the atlas.
不勾选则继承所属场景的方法。: Leave unchecked to inherit the scenario’s methods.
可填写纯文本或安全 HTML。: Enter plain text or safe HTML.
独立演示页代码，可包含脚本；保存后在沙箱中运行。: Standalone demo page code, including scripts. It runs in a sandbox after saving.
手动填写名称、分类及内容，无需预先制作 case.json。也可先导入文件，再调: Enter the metadata and content without preparing case.json. Or import files first, then edit the original metadata fields.
表单中的名称、ID、场景、方法、版本和日期会覆盖导入清单中的对应字段。: The form’s title, ID, scenario, methods, version and date override the corresponding manifest fields.
请填写案例名称、有效 ID、所属场景和背景内容。: Complete the title, valid ID, scenario and background content.
id 必须为英文小写、数字、连字符: The ID must use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
案例 id 重复，请先删除已有版本: Duplicate case ID; remove the existing version first
清单不得包含 script 标签: The manifest must not contain script tags
HTML 缺少 atlas-case-manifest 元信息: The HTML file has no atlas-case-manifest metadata
需要唯一 case.json 或 *.case.json: Exactly one case.json or *.case.json is required
导入内容使用作者原文。: Imported content is displayed in its author’s language.
在添加案例窗口切换到手动添加，填写基本信息、背景和流程，可选填演示 HTML。: Choose Manual entry in the add-case dialog. Enter the metadata, background and workflow; demo HTML is optional.
